title: Nepal Police — DNA profiling for unidentified remains
citation: Nepal Police HQ — Information on DNA Profiling for unidentified Dead Bodies (31 Aug)
body: Nepal Police asks relatives of people missing after the Rasuwa / Bhote Koshi floods to help identify recovered bodies through DNA. In Nepal: first-degree relatives (father, mother, son or daughter) can give a fresh blood sample plus two passport-size photos at Nepal Police Hospital Pathology Lab, Maharajgunj, or the nearest District Police Office. Abroad: get DNA profiling at an authorised forensic lab and email the report to dnacodis@nepalpolice.gov.np with the missing person’s name, nationality, ID/passport details, place/date of disappearance if known, and relationship. Contact: Police Inspector Sambhu Bahadur KC, +977-9841616095. Always follow Nepal Police instructions on the original post.
